_readme: Add only sources you own or are licensed to stream. Keys: 'movie:<tmdbId>', 'tv:<tmdbId>' or 'tv:<tmdbId>:s<season>e<episode>'. Values: array of { label, url } where url is an .m3u8 (HLS) or .mp4 link. HTTPS plays directly. HTTP sources are routed through /api/media-proxy and their host (plus any CDN hosts referenced by HLS manifests) must be listed in MEDIA_PROXY_ALLOWED_HOSTS.
